sponsored.t: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law relating to the taking of sharks.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to lease such lands for cell tower installation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the town of Brookhaven to alienate certain lands used as parklands and to lease such lands for a cell tower installation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Chabad at Stony Brook, Inc.
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven, county of Suffolk, to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from Chabad at Stony Brook, Inc. for all of the 2025 general taxes and all of the 2025 school taxes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the whale awareness act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the whale awareness act directing the department of environmental conservation to establish recommendations and educational materials for reduction of marine mammal interactions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the conveyance of a conservation easement over certain state-owned lands in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, Suffolk County
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of transportation to grant a perpetual conservation easement to certain entities over certain state-owned lands in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, Suffolk County.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 1 Chapter 164 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 10341, entitled: "AN ACT in relation to authorizing and directing the conveyance of a conservation easement over certain state-owned lands in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station, Suffolk County" APPROVED This bill would provide the public with continuous access to certain lands located in the hamlets of Setauket and Port Jefferson Station (the "Existing Greenway Property"), Suffolk County, through the granting of a permanent conservation easement by the New York State Department of Transportation ("NYSDOT"), while permitting limited fixture modification or rerouting to accommodate certain public purposes and subject to certain conditions. Specifically, while the bill would restrict roadway development, the Metropolitan Transportation Authority ("MTA") would retain the ability to utilize the…

sponsored.t: Relates to certain reforms for agencies subject to the freedom of information law
sponsored.sum: Requires agencies subject to FOIL requirements to promulgate rules and regulations regarding to whom a requestor may appeal a denial and how to request records from or appeal a denial; makes certain provisions relating to publication of contact information for FOIL requests and appeals.

sponsored.t: Relates to food service item waste reduction
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public food service establishments operating in the state from providing excess food service items including single-use utensils, condiments, napkins and extra containers, to any customer except upon, and in accordance with, the express request of that customer.

sponsored.t: Requires mobile sports wagering operators to share monthly invoice statements to authorized consumers
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires mobile sports wagering operators to share monthly invoice statements to authorized consumers; specifies information required.

sponsored.t: Relates to a prohibition on chatbot toys
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture, exchange, distribution and sale of chatbot toys in this state.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage scup
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage scup to December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-nine.

sponsored.t: Requires require prospective licensees of cannabis licenses to submit a formal attestation of compliance with local zoning laws, land-use regulations, and municipal code requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires prospective licensees of cannabis licenses to submit a formal attestation of compliance with local zoning laws, land-use regulations, and municipal code requirements and proof of local municipal compliance to the Cannabis Control Board when applying for an OCM Cannabis license, and give municipalities the ability to request an extension of time to submit an opinion on the prospective licensee application.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting of drinking water lead testing in schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health, in consultation with the commissioner of education, to create and issue a five-year plan with proposals to best mitigate the persistence of lead in schools.

sponsored.t: Requires utilities to automatically enroll customers over the age of fifty-five in any available savings programs
sponsored.sum: Requires utilities to automatically enroll customers over the age of fifty-five in any available savings programs.

sponsored.t: Requires applicants for a permit, registration, or license issued by the cannabis control board to report any relevant law enforcement interactions that occur during the application review process
sponsored.sum: Requires applicants for a permit, registration, or license issued by the cannabis control board to report any relevant law enforcement interactions that occur during the application review process; provides for automatic denial of such application for failure to make such report.

sponsored.t: Requires the commissioner of transportation establishes an interactive website for reporting defects on public highways
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of transportation to establish an interactive website for reporting defects on public highways.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for same-sex couples re-recording their property deeds to reflect a change in status from tenants in common or joint tenants with right of survivorship to tenancy by the entirety
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for same-sex couples who purchased residential property in the state prior to the legalization of same-sex marriage, were prohibited from recording the deed as tenants by the entirety, and who re-record the deed to reflect a change in status from tenants in common or joint tenants with right of survivorship to tenants by the entirety; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators from conditioning the withdrawal of funds on a requirement that a sports bettor first wager deposited funds
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators from imposing any condition requiring an authorized sports bettor to wager deposited funds as a prerequisite to withdrawing such funds.

sponsored.t: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators or platform providers from permitting, accepting, or facilitating placement of a sports wager through a mobile application from any individual on a NY college campus
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators or platform providers from permitting, accepting, or facilitating the placement of a sports wager through a mobile application or platform from any individual on a college campus in the state; requires mobile sports betting platforms to implement geofencing restrictions on campuses and properties; limits exposure to gambling for college-aged students; reduces distractions in academic settings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the penalty for the abandonment of animals
sponsored.sum: Provides that the penalty for the abandonment of animals is a misdemeanor, punishable by imprisonment for not more than one year, or by a fine of not less than five hundred dollars nor more than one thousand dollars, or by both.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to the department of civil service allowing municipalities to post municipal employment positions on the department of civil service's state jobs website
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law relating to the department of civil service allowing municipalities to post municipal employment positions on the department of civil service's state jobs website.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the New York Liquidation Bureau to establish a reimbursement program for eligible local educational agencies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the New York Liquidation Bureau to establish a program to evaluate and reimburse eligible local educational agencies for monetary liabilities arising from civil claims or settlement agreements related to certain acts that occurred during a period covered by a liability insurance policy issued by an insolvent insurer.

sponsored.t: Increases the income cap for purposes of the Excelsior scholarship
sponsored.sum: Increases the income cap for purposes of the Excelsior scholarship from $125,000 to $150,000 for academic years 2026-2027 and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Establishes a private right of action for malicious disclosure of personally identifying information by another individual
sponsored.sum: Establishes a private right of action for any person whose personally identifying information was intentionally disclosed by another individual, without consent, for the purpose of harassing, threatening, intimidating, or causing harm to such person, or with reckless disregard as to whether such disclosure would cause such harm; defines personal information.

sponsored.t: Requires the state university of New York to install solar canopies on its campuses
sponsored.sum: Requires the state university of New York to install solar canopies on its campuses.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the transportation of dogs in the back of a motor vehicle intended for any load
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the transportation of dogs in the back of a motor vehicle intended for any load unless such space is enclosed or has side and tail racks to a height of not less than forty-six inches extending vertically from the floor; the motor vehicle has installed means of preventing the dog from being ejected; or the dog is cross-tethered to the vehicle or is protected by a secured container or cage, in a manner which will prevent the dog from being ejected from the motor vehicle; imposes fines for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing enhanced cancer disability benefits to volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Provides that the tax levy limit shall not include a tax levy necessary for expenditures resulting from a local government meeting its obligation to provide enhanced cancer disability benefits to volunteer firefighters as required under section two hundred five-cc of the general municipal law.

sponsored.t: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a family fare ticket policy
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to establish a family fare ticket policy for minors aged twelve through seventeen.

sponsored.t: Creates the office of older adult workforce development within the office for the aging
sponsored.sum: Creates the office of older adult workforce development within the office for the aging to address the needs of older adults regarding the workplace.

sponsored.t: Provides that the commissioner of education may promulgate rules and regulations for a health education curriculum to include menstrual disorders
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of education may promulgate rules and regulations for a health education curriculum to include menstrual disorders, including but not limited to, endometriosis.

sponsored.t: Relates to including the Asian longhorned tick and lone star tick on the invasive species list
sponsored.sum: Relates to including the Asian longhorned tick and lone star tick on the invasive species list, and include them in the comprehensive plan for invasive species management.

sponsored.t: Allows for a modest increase in annual income to not disqualify someone from the excelsior scholarship
sponsored.sum: Allows for a modest increase in annual income, not greater than three percent per year, to not disqualify someone from the excelsior scholarship.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of residential automatic pesticide misting systems
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of residential automatic pesticide misting systems.

sponsored.t: Directs the authorities budget office to conduct a study on the financial effects of making local governments responsible for the upkeep in certain public areas
sponsored.sum: Directs the authorities budget office to conduct a study on the financial effects of making local governments responsible for the upkeep in certain public areas immediately outside of properties owned or leased by public authorities.

sponsored.t: Relates to building aid for incremental zero-emission school bus infrastructure costs
sponsored.sum: Relates to building aid for incremental zero-emission school bus infrastructure costs provided through the 2034-2035 school year.

sponsored.t: Relates to assaults against water authority employees
sponsored.sum: Elevates assault to a felony when committed against a water authority employee in the course of performing their duties.

sponsored.t: Allows for SNAP benefits to be used to purchase menstrual products
sponsored.sum: Allows for SNAP benefits to be used to purchase menstrual products including, but not limited to, sanitary napkins, tampons and panty liners.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state veteran student loan forgiveness program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state veteran student loan forgiveness program; awards up to $10,000 per year for five years, for eligible applicants.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to request an extension of the Clean Pass Program in the state
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of transportation to submit a request for an extension of the Clean Pass Program in the state to the United States Department of Transportation.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York traffic reduction act
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of motor vehicles to establish and administer a program authorizing eligible vehicles to operate in designated high-occupancy vehicle (HOV) lanes, notwithstanding vehicle occupancy.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the location of cannabis retail locations within two hundred feet of an addiction treatment center
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the location of cannabis retail locations within two hundred feet of an addiction treatment center; defines addiction treatment center.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of civil service to allow municipalities to post municipal employment positions on the department of civil service's state jobs website
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of civil service to allow municipalities to post municipal employment positions on the department of civil service's state jobs website; requires such municipal employment opportunities to be posted in a format searchable by municipality and employment position type.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 45 Chapter 664 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 8023-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the civil service law, in relation to requiring the department of civil service to allow municipalities to post municipal employment positions on the department of civil service's state jobs website" APPROVED This bill would require the Department of Civil Service to allow municipal governments to promote job openings on the State Jobs website to expand their applicant pool. I support providing better online access to municipal government job openings. The Department of Civil Service is currently engaged in a large-scale transformation of the civil service merit system, including developing a new jobs portal and applicant management system to stream- line recruitment, modernize the hiring process, and improve efficiency. The goals of this bill will fit well within the…

sponsored.t: Permits the Setauket fire district and Stony Brook fire district to enter into contracts with the state university of New York at Stony Brook for property, services, and other consideration
sponsored.sum: Permits the Setauket fire district and Stony Brook fire district to enter into contracts with the state university of New York at Stony Brook for property, services, and other consideration.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from St. Mary AME Zion Church
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the assessor of the town of Brookhaven to accept an application for a real property tax exemption from St. Mary AME Zion Church for the property located at 537 Granny Road in the Hamlet of Medford.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to SB Clinical Practice Management Plan, Inc. for the construction of facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to SB Clinical Practice Management Plan, Inc. for the construction of facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the department of environmental conservation's management of hard clams, soft or steamer clams and razor clams
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation from December 31, 2025 until December 31, 2028 to adopt by regulation measures for the management of hard clams, soft or steamer clams or razor clams.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage alewife
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage alewife.

sponsored.t: Directs the Department of Transportation to grant a permanent access and construction easement to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority
sponsored.sum: Directs the Department of Transportation to grant a permanent access and construction easement to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority for the use of a portion of DOT-owned land to support potential future rail yard development.

sponsored.t: Provides reimbursement for enhanced septic system projects
sponsored.sum: Provides reimbursement for enhanced septic system projects and defines what qualifies as an enhanced septic system project.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the lease of certain lands of state university of New York at Stony Brook for the purpose of building undergraduate student, graduate student, faculty and staff housing
sponsored.sum: Directs the state university trustees, without any public bidding, to lease and otherwise contract to make a portion of the lands of SUNY Stony Brook on its campus to the Stony Brook Housing Development Corp. for the purpose of building undergraduate student, graduate student, faculty and staff housing; limits such lease to a period not exceeding 100 years.

sponsored.t: Relates to municipal websites
sponsored.sum: Removes requirements for certain smaller municipalities to maintain official websites.
